invplt.desc: A heavy plate mail cuirass of grey steel: a battered smooth one-piece grey steel breastplate with a single vertical central ridge and a plain flat chest, articulated grey steel shoulder plates and a skirt of overlapping grey steel lames, mail visible underneath, a few leather straps. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
